```{r Summarize number of samples}
output_dir <- file.path(directory, "Weeklong-Sample-collection", "Sample-breakdown")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

meta <- samples %>%
    filter(!SEQ %in% c("NA", "N") 
         & !is.na(SEQ)
         & !Sample_ID %in% duplicate_samples
         & Kit_ID != "Unknown")

for (sid in unique(meta$Subject_ID)) {
  
  temp <- meta %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid) %>%
    select(Subject_ID, Sample_ID, Kit_ID, Sample_origin2, Region, Collection_date, Collection_time, Transit_time_h, pH, Bristol_score, Frozen) %>%
    arrange(Collection_date, Collection_time, Region)
  
  # print table to pdf nicely
  gt(temp) %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(10)) %>% # fontsize
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), # bold headers
              locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) %>%
    gtsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Sample-collection/Sample-breakdown/Sample-breakdown-", sid, ".pdf"))
}

output_dir <- file.path(directory, "Weeklong-Sample-collection", "Kit-breakdown")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

for (sid in unique(kits$Subject_ID)) {
  
  temp <- kits %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid) %>%
    select(Kit_ID, Subject_ID, Timepoint, Ingestion_date, Ingestion_time, Saliva, Cap_R1, Stool) %>%
    arrange(Timepoint)
  
  # print table to pdf nicely
  gt(temp) %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(10)) %>% # fontsize
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), # bold headers
              locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) %>%
    gtsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Sample-collection/Kit-breakdown/Kit-breakdown-", sid, ".pdf"))
}

meta_counts <- meta %>%
  
  # Count samples per region
  group_by(Subject_ID, Region) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Region_grouped = ifelse(Region %in% c("R1", "R2", "R3"), "Regions", Region)) %>%
  group_by(Subject_ID, Region_grouped) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = sum(n_samples), .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  # Add total_samples and unique_capscan as extra "regions"
  group_by(Subject_ID) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    summarise(
      ., 
      Region_grouped = c("Total", "Devices"),
      n_samples = c(
        sum(n_samples),
        n_distinct(meta$Capscan_ID[meta$Subject_ID == unique(Subject_ID) 
                                      & !meta$Capscan_ID %in% c("NA", "Missing") & !is.na(meta$Capscan_ID)] )
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Region_grouped = factor(Region_grouped, levels = c("Stool", "Regions", "Devices", "Saliva", "Total")))

g <- ggplot(meta_counts, aes(x = Subject_ID, y = Region_grouped, fill = n_samples)) +
     geom_tile(color = "black") +
     geom_text(aes(label = n_samples), color = "black", size = 2) +
     scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
     coord_fixed() + 
     labs(title = "Samples per subject by region", x = "Subject ID", y = "Region", fill = "Count") +
     theme_custom_text() +
     theme(axis.text.x = element_text(),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +
      guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
      ticks.colour = "black",
      frame.colour = "black",
      frame.linewidth = 0.2))

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Weeklong-Sample-collection/Samples-summary.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 1.5, width = 5)


capsule_counts <- meta %>%
  filter(Region %in% c("R1", "R2", "R3")) %>%  # Only R1, R2, R3

  group_by(Subject_ID, Sample_origin) %>%

    n_samples = sum(!SEQ %in% c("NA", "N")),  # count rows where SEQ is not "NA"
```

#######################################
# Ingestion and collection timeline
#######################################

```{r Individual ingestion times}

meta <- samples %>%
    filter(Kit_ID != "Unknown")

for (sid in unique(meta$Subject_ID)) {
  # Filter and clean metadata for this subject
  temp <- meta %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Ingestion_date) & Ingestion_date != "NA") %>%
    filter(Subject_ID == sid, grepl("Capscan", Sample_origin)) %>%
    select(Subject_ID, Kit_ID, Capscan_ID, Sample_origin, Ingestion_date, Ingestion_time, Collection_date, Collection_time, Transit_time_h) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # Handle missing collection dates/times
  Latemp_date <- max(ymd(temp$Collection_date), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  meta_fixed <- temp %>%
    mutate(
      Collection_date = if_else(Collection_date == "NA", as.character(Latemp_date), Collection_date),
      Collection_time = if_else(Collection_time == "NA", "23:59", Collection_time),
      Ingestion_datetime  = ymd_hm(paste(Ingestion_date, Ingestion_time), tz = "UTC"),
      Collection_datetime = ymd_hm(paste(Collection_date, Collection_time), tz = "UTC"),
      Capscan_ID = toupper(trimws(Capscan_ID)),
      # Compute center and width for geom_tile
      x_center = Ingestion_datetime + (Collection_datetime - Ingestion_datetime) / 2,
      x_width = as.numeric(difftime(Collection_datetime, Ingestion_datetime, units = "secs"))
    )
  
  # Plot timeline
  g <- ggplot(meta_fixed, aes(y = Sample_origin)) +
    geom_tile(
      aes(x = x_center, width = x_width, height = 0.8, alpha = if_else(Capscan_ID == "MISSING", 0.5, 1), linetype = if_else(Capscan_ID == "MISSING", "dashed", "solid")), fill = "#0000FF", color = "black") +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    geom_text(aes(x = x_center, label = sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(Transit_time_h))), color = "white", size = 2) +
    scale_linetype_identity() +
    scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%m/%d", date_breaks = "1 day") +
    labs(title = paste0("Subject ", sid), y = NULL, x = NULL) +
    theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    theme_custom_text()
  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Sample-collection/Timeline-breakdown/Timeline-breakdown-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 0.22*length(meta_fixed$Sample_origin) + 0.4, width = 4)
  
  if (sid == "20") {
      ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Sample-collection/Timeline-breakdown/Timeline-breakdown-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 0.22*length(meta_fixed$Sample_origin) + 0.4, width = 5)
  }
}

```

```{r Summarize ingestion times}

# Filter and clean metadata
df2plot <- meta %>% 
    filter(grepl("Capscan", Sample_origin)) %>%
    filter(Transit_time_h != 0) %>%
    select(Subject_ID, Kit_ID, Sample_origin, Capscan_ID, Transit_time_h) %>%
    distinct()

df2plot <- df2plot %>%
  mutate(Transit_time_h = ifelse(is.na(Transit_time_h), 0, Transit_time_h)) %>%
  mutate(Transit_time_h = as.numeric(Transit_time_h))

avg_transit <- mean(df2plot$Transit_time_h, na.rm = TRUE)

g <- ggplot(df2plot %>% filter(Transit_time_h > 0), aes(x = Transit_time_h)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "blue", color = "black", boundary = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
   geom_vline(xintercept = avg_transit, color = "red", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100, 125, 150)) +
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = avg_transit + 25, y = max(40),
    label = paste("Avg:", round(avg_transit, 1), "h"), 
    color = "red", angle = 0, vjust = 0, size = 2
  ) +
  labs(x = "Transit time (h)", y = "Count") +
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  theme_custom_text()
  
ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Sample-collection/Transit-time-distribution.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 1.5, width = 2)

avg_transit_by_subject <- df2plot %>%
  group_by(Subject_ID) %>%
  summarise(avg_transit = mean(Transit_time_h, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

df2plot <- df2plot %>%
  left_join(avg_transit_by_subject, by = "Subject_ID")

g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = Transit_time_h)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "blue", color = "black", boundary = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = avg_transit), color = "red", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Subject_ID, scales = "fixed", ncol = 5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of transit time", x = "Transit time (hours)", y = "Count") +
  geom_text(data = avg_transit_by_subject,
            aes(x = avg_transit + 45, y = 5, label = paste("Avg:", round(avg_transit, 1), "h")),
            color = "red", angle = 0, vjust = 0, size = 2,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +  # important to use only the data in avg_transit_by_subject
  theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory,"/Weeklong-Sample-collection/Transit-time-facet-distribution.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 5, width = 5)

```

```{r PANAS}

data_lf <- panas %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Positive_affect_score, Negative_affect_score), names_to = "Direction", values_to = "Affect_score", 
                 values_drop_na = FALSE)

data_lf <- data_lf %>%
  mutate(Direction = gsub("_.*", "", Direction))

data_lf <- data_lf %>%
  mutate(Direction = recode(Direction,
                            "Positive" = "P",
                            "Negative" = "N"))

g <- ggplot(data_lf, aes(x = Direction, y = Subject_ID, fill = Affect_score, label = Affect_score)) + 
     geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) + 
     facet_nested(cols = vars(Day), scales = "free_y", space = "free", drop=TRUE) +
     scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
     geom_text(size = 2) +
     scale_x_discrete("Affect score, by day (negative & postiive)") +
     theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
           axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
           axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
           panel.background = element_blank(),
           strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
           legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Legend text size
           legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
           legend.frame = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
           legend.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +  # Size of the legend keys (symbol or color box) 
     theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Weeklong-Sample-collection/PANAS-summary.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 5)

data_lf <- panas %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Interested, Distressed, Excited, Upset, Strong, Guilty, Scared, Hostile, Enthusiastic, Proud, Irritable, Alert, Ashamed, Inspired, Nervous, Determined, Attentive, Jittery, Active, Afraid), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Score", 
                 values_drop_na = FALSE)

for (sid in unique(panas$Subject_ID)) {

g <- ggplot(data_lf %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid), aes(x = Parameter, y = Day, fill = Score)) + 
     geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) + 
     facet_nested(cols = vars(Subject_ID), scales = "free_y", space = "free", drop = TRUE) +
     scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue", limits = c(1, 5)) +
     scale_x_discrete("Parameter") +
     theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
           axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
           axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
           axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
           panel.background = element_blank(),
           strip.text = element_text(angle = 0),
           strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
           strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
           legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Legend text size
           legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +  # Size of the legend keys (symbol or color box) 
           guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1,     # Number of columns in the legend
                           byrow = TRUE)) + # Fill the legend items by row
      theme_custom_text()

# Save composition figure
ggsave(paste0(directory, "Weeklong-Sample-collection/PANAS-breakdown/PANAS-components-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 3, height = 2)
}
```

#######################################
# Diet nutrients
#######################################

```{r diet nutrients}

data_lf <- macronutrients %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Date_reformat, Subject_ID), 
               names_to = "Nutrient", 
               values_to = "Value", 
               values_drop_na = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(nutrient_type, by = "Nutrient") %>%
  mutate(Daily_amount = as.numeric(ifelse(Daily_amount == "NA", NA, Daily_amount)),
         Percent_daily = case_when(
           is.na(Daily_amount) ~ NA_real_,
           TRUE ~ Value / Daily_amount * 100
         )) %>%
  mutate(Percent_daily_capped = ifelse(Percent_daily > 300, 301, Percent_daily))


g <- ggplot(data_lf, aes(x = Date_reformat, y = Nutrient, fill = Percent_daily_capped)) + 
     geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) + 
     facet_nested(rows = vars(Category), cols = vars(Subject_ID), scales = "free", space = "free", drop = TRUE) +
     scale_fill_gradientn(
       colors = c("white", "blue", "#0000cc"),
       values = scales::rescale(c(0, 3, 3.01)),
       na.value = "grey90",
       limits = c(0, 301),
       breaks = c(0, 100, 200, 300, 301),
       labels = c("0%", "100%", "200%", "300%", ">300%"))+
     theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
           axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
           axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
           axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
           panel.background = element_blank(),
           strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
           legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Legend text size
           legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +  # Size of the legend keys (symbol or color box) 
           guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1,     # Number of columns in the legend
                           byrow = TRUE)) + # Fill the legend items by row
      theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory,"/Weeklong-Sample-collection/Nutrient-distribution.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 8, width = 24)


for (sid in unique(data_lf$Subject_ID)) {
```

#######################################
# Diet log
#######################################

```{r Summarize diet}

output_dir <- file.path(directory, "Weeklong-Sample-collection", "Sample-breakdown")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

meta <- samples %>%
    filter(!SEQ %in% c("NA", "N") 
         & !is.na(SEQ)
         & !Sample_ID %in% duplicate_samples
         & Kit_ID != "Unknown")

for (sid in unique(meta$Subject_ID)) {
  
  temp <- meta %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid) %>%
    select(Subject_ID, Sample_ID, Kit_ID, Sample_origin2, Region, Collection_date, Collection_time, Transit_time_h, pH, Bristol_score, Frozen) %>%
    arrange(Collection_date, Collection_time, Region)
  
  # print table to pdf nicely
  gt(temp) %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(10)) %>% # fontsize
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), # bold headers
              locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) %>%
    gtsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Sample-collection/Sample-breakdown/Sample-breakdown-", sid, ".pdf"))
}

output_dir <- file.path(directory, "Weeklong-Sample-collection", "Kit-breakdown")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

for (sid in unique(kits$Subject_ID)) {
  
  temp <- kits %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid) %>%
    select(Kit_ID, Subject_ID, Timepoint, Ingestion_date, Ingestion_time, Saliva, Cap_R1, Stool) %>%
    arrange(Timepoint)
  
  # print table to pdf nicely
  gt(temp) %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(10)) %>% # fontsize
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), # bold headers
              locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) %>%
    gtsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Sample-collection/Kit-breakdown/Kit-breakdown-", sid, ".pdf"))
}

meta_counts <- meta %>%
  
  # Count samples per region
  group_by(Subject_ID, Region) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Region_grouped = ifelse(Region %in% c("R1", "R2", "R3"), "Regions", Region)) %>%
  group_by(Subject_ID, Region_grouped) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = sum(n_samples), .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  # Add total_samples and unique_capscan as extra "regions"
  group_by(Subject_ID) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    summarise(
      ., 
      Region_grouped = c("Total", "Devices"),
      n_samples = c(
        sum(n_samples),
        n_distinct(meta$Capscan_ID[meta$Subject_ID == unique(Subject_ID) 
                                      & !meta$Capscan_ID %in% c("NA", "Missing") & !is.na(meta$Capscan_ID)] )
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Region_grouped = factor(Region_grouped, levels = c("Stool", "Regions", "Devices", "Saliva", "Total")))

g <- ggplot(meta_counts, aes(x = Subject_ID, y = Region_grouped, fill = n_samples)) +
     geom_tile(color = "black") +
     geom_text(aes(label = n_samples), color = "black", size = 2) +
     scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
     coord_fixed() + 
     labs(title = "Samples per subject by region", x = "Subject ID", y = "Region", fill = "Count") +
     theme_custom_text() +
     theme(axis.text.x = element_text(),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +
      guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
      ticks.colour = "black",
      frame.colour = "black",
      frame.linewidth = 0.2))

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Weeklong-Sample-collection/Samples-summary.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 1.5, width = 5)


capsule_counts <- meta %>%
  filter(Region %in% c("R1", "R2", "R3")) %>%  # Only R1, R2, R3
  filter(SEQ == "Y") %>%
  group_by(Subject_ID, Sample_origin) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = sum(!SEQ %in% c("NA", "N")),  # count rows where SEQ is not "NA"
    .groups = "drop"
  )

avg_regions <- round(mean(capsule_counts$n_samples, na.rm = TRUE), 2)

counts <- capsule_counts %>%
  count(n_samples, Subject_ID)

g <- ggplot(counts, aes(x = factor(n_samples), y = n, fill = Subject_ID)) +
     geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
     scale_fill_manual(values = turbo(21, direction = -1)) +
     theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
     labs(x = "Number of regions", y = "Count") +
     guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 4)) +
     theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
     theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Weeklong-Sample-collection/Capsule-regions-distribution.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 2, width = 4)
```

#######################################
# PSS
#######################################

```{r PSS}

data_lf <- pre_PSS %>%
  select(1:12) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Subject_ID), 
               names_to = "Parameter", 
               values_to = "Value", 
               values_drop_na = FALSE)

# Create separate datasets for PSS_sum and other parameters
data_pss_sum <- data_lf %>% filter(Parameter == "Score")
data_other <- data_lf %>% filter(Parameter != "Score")

question_labels <- c(
  "Q1" = "Q1: been upset because of something unexpected",
  "Q2" = "Q2: felt unable to control important things",
  "Q3" = "Q3: felt nervous and 'stressed'",
  "Q4" = "Q4: felt confident about handling personal problems",
  "Q5" = "Q5: felt that things were going your way",
  "Q6" = "Q6: found you could not cope with all things to do",
  "Q7" = "Q7: been able to control irritations",
  "Q8" = "Q8: felt that you were on top of things",
  "Q9" = "Q9: been angered by things outside your control",
  "Q10" = "Q10: felt difficulties piling up too high"
)

# Create the plot with two separate scales
g <- ggplot() + 
     # First layer: Other parameters (white to blue)
     geom_tile(data = data_other, 
               aes(x = Parameter, y = Subject_ID, fill = Value),
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) + 
     geom_text(data = data_other,
               aes(x = Parameter, y = Subject_ID, label = Value),
               size = 2) +
     scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue",
                        limits = c(0, 4),
                        breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4),
                        labels = c("0-Never", "1-Almost never", "2-Sometimes", 
                                  "3-Fairly often", "4-Very often"),
                        name = "Frequency") +
     guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1,     # Number of columns in the legend
                             byrow = TRUE)) + # Fill the legend items by row
     new_scale_fill() +
     
     # Second layer: PSS_sum (white to red)
     geom_tile(data = data_pss_sum, 
               aes(x = Parameter, y = Subject_ID, fill = Value),
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) + 
     geom_text(data = data_pss_sum,
               aes(x = Parameter, y = Subject_ID, label = Value),
               size = 2) +
     scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("white", "yellow", "orange", "red"),
                         values = scales::rescale(c(0, 13, 26, 40)),
                         limits = c(0, 40),
                         breaks = c(6.5, 20, 33),
                         labels = c("Low (0-13)", "Moderate (14-26)", "High (27-40)"),
                         name = "Stress Level") +
     
     theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
           axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
           axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
           panel.background = element_blank(),
           strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
           legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
           legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +
     guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1,     # Number of columns in the legend
                             byrow = TRUE)) + # Fill the legend items by row
     theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory,"/Weeklong-Sample-collection/PSS-distribution.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 4, width = 6)


```
